title: Compile & Diagnose
summary: Compiles a project or unit and folds the compiler's errors and warnings into drag-lint findings
intro: Read this when you want compiler errors and warnings for the current file or project inside the IDE. It compiles the project or unit and folds the compiler messages into drag-lint findings.

steps: Open the file or project in the IDE
The compiler messages appear as drag-lint findings

questions.ask: How do I see compiler errors and warnings for the current file inside the IDE?
